Corrected legacy parity for legacy_alias_060, legacy_alias_061 and legacy_alias_062: legacy_normalized_value and scope changed from gypsum_board_moisture_resistant to gypsum_board_regular. Classification remains context_required; automatic subtype resolution remains forbidden.
